# y2conjoint

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

y2conjoint provides data structures and function for working with conjoint data

## Installation

You can install the development version of y2conjoint from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("y2analytics/y2conjoint")
```
